necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent palpitations in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, corresponding to diagnosis code I48.0. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management. This diagnostic monitoring is essential for evaluating the clinical indication of syncope and palpitations to ensure appropriate patient care.
